summary: 41 units (43-83) reviewed: 4 errors, 15 minor. Errors are case/attachment problems in translations (53 Jātavedas accusative taken as vocative; 63 Savitṛ's epithets attached to 'you'; 68 'Agni and you two'). Others are minor wording/label points. No regrouping needed: the drafter's grouping notes (46, 57, 58, 60, 61) are sensible and the edition's grouping can stay. Low-confidence units 47, 61, 65, 71, 77 are honestly rated; unit 61 additionally needs a decision on avaṭa/text_flags.
